original.statement: Config Management Plugins now receive empty environment variables that were previously not passed.

corrected.statement: Argo CD now passes environment variables with empty values to config management plugins (CMP).

decision.reason: [ev-dd28456702c2] says only "feat(cmp): pass empty env vars to plugins". That supports behavior-changed: config management plugins now receive env vars with empty values. The proposed name "cmp-env-var-passing" leaves out "empty", which is what this change is about. It also uses "passing", which is not one of the evidence's own words, so the name could cover any change to how CMP env vars are passed. The kebab-case name built from the evidence's key words is "cmp-empty-env-vars".
